text: The blanked HIGH on in/expiry-payroll-foundation 93ce5daf (the secret filter took the long migration path for a key; fixed on main): [HIGH] apps/api/src/db/migrations/0126_expiry_commerce.sql:174 — the new CHECKs on the live tables product_barcodes (no BTOEXP- codes) and expiry_items (no NaN, line 176) are validated against every existing row; one such row fails the deploy, and a migration cannot be rolled back. The owner's preflight was not run. Wanted: add both CHECKs NOT VALID (new and changed rows are still checked; existing rows are not scanned), say so in the commit message and ADR-0245, and push the branch again. Everything else was fine: suites 52/52 suites, 186/186 tests green; money in Decimal, append-only tables, routes and rights, one added i18n key. The owner lets reviewed green work land without asking (ADR-0250), so the next push lands by itself once the reviewer approves.
